user.title: Add an Onkyo receiver
user.description: Enter the address of the receiver. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant, with network control enabled.

data_description.port: The eISCP port. Leave it at 60128 unless you changed it.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add the receiver at {host} to Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the receiver. Check the address and that network control is on.
error.no_identity: The receiver did not report its identity.
error.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different receiver.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses that address.

abort.already_configured: This receiver is already set up.
abort.core_conflict: The core Onkyo integration already uses this receiver. The receiver allows one connection per computer, so remove that entry first.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different receiver.

abort.not_loaded: The receiver is not connected right now. Try again when it is.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Pick an input to rename or hide it. Leave the field empty and submit to go back.

input_edit.title: Edit input {code}
input_edit.description: An empty name goes back to the receiver's own name.

input_order.title: Order of inputs
input_order.description: Clear the field, then pick the inputs in the order you want them in the source list. Inputs you leave out follow in the receiver's order.

listening_modes.title: Listening modes
listening_modes.description: Pick a listening mode to rename or hide it. Leave the field empty and submit to go back.

mode_edit.title: Edit listening mode {code}
mode_edit.description: An empty name goes back to the standard name.

data.name: Name
data.hidden: Hide from the listening mode list

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: The maximum volume is 100 % on the volume slider; Home Assistant never sets the receiver above it.

data.restore_volume: Put the volume back after power on

data_description.restore_volume: Some receivers jump to a loud level at power on. When on, the volume from before standby is set again.

error.name_in_use: Another entry already uses this name.

not_available.message: The receiver does not allow this right now.

zone_power_refused.message: The receiver refused to switch this zone on.
